name: P7_photo_analyzer
role: Describe one listing photo as room facts (spec 11.2 step 5, 9.4 P7): room type, beds, furniture, appliances, bathroom fixtures, windows and daylight, condition and its visible signs, furnished, whether text can still be read and whether a person is in view. Runs on the blurred copy. Contradictions with the listing text are computed in code, not by the model (D-081).
